pet_notes: Kusanagi Nene from 2-star card960 res015_no036, Edo event vintage Western dress, chibi Japanese anime illustration. Long pale sage-gray loose hair, violet eyes, a small front braid with gold rose clasp on her LEFT shoulder. Charcoal flat-crown boater hat with narrow black brim, forest-green and gold patterned band; black flower/loop/gold-tassel ornament on her RIGHT side (screen-left when frontal). Cream-white ruffled collar, charcoal elbow-length puff sleeves and ruffled cuffs, forest-green geometric-pattern bodice, black central placket with small white buttons, black boned corset waist with gold fasteners, blue-green/gold draped waist cords and attached tassels. Ankle-length charcoal bell skirt with forest-green draped front panel. Black gloves and deep-green wrist bows. User-approved unseen lower-body completion: compact long skirt and black round-toe lace-up ankle boots. LEFT gloved hand holds an open dark-teal folding fan with gold pleated outer edge near upper chest below the mouth, attached to hand/body; eyes and nose remain visible. Free RIGHT hand is the gesture hand. Compact big-head, short-limbed proportions, about2.1heads high; not a tall fashion figure. Reserved elegant small smile. No kimono, school uniform, stage outfit, loose props or new symbols.
